name_input: FLOWSTAR ENGINEERING PRIVATE LIMITED; FLOW STAR ENGINEERING PVT. LTD
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for FLOWSTAR ENGINEERING PRIVATE LIMITED (address 264-D.D.A. FLATS, BADARPUR) shows "Total Shipments 70 Records detected", "Latest Cargo 2025-12-30", "Trading Partners 2", "Ports 4". Exact export row quoted: "2025-12-30 | FLOWSTAR ENGINEERING PRIVATE LIMITED | MOUNT EVEREST DISTILLERY LTD. | GLASS TUBE ROTAMETER 0% | SONAULI LCS, India | Bhairawa, NEPAL | 90261010 | 8334427". Second export row: "2025-11-18 | FLOWSTAR ENGINEERING PRIVATE LIMITED | MUSIM MAS PT | TABULAR LEVEL INDICATOR WITH ISOLATION V | DELHI AIR, India | MEDAN, Indonesia | 90261090 | 3193707". Buyer-side aggregates also list MOUNT EVEREST DISTILLERY LTD. (8 shipments, Nepal), MUSIM MAS PT (6, Indonesia), INTIBEUNA PERKASATAMA PT (2, Indonesia), MS VEEN WATERS BHUTAN PRIVATE LIMITED (6, Bhutan). Source counter: page claims 70 total shipments; rows actually visible in the free view = 5 (2 outbound export rows + 3 inbound import rows), so 65 rows are behind the paywall and unverified.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender, contract or annual-report split found in the sources reachable. The only India-side records visible are inbound imports (e.g. "2025-04-15 | ZHENGZHOU SHENTAI INSTRUMENT MANUFA | FLOWSTAR ENGINEERING PRIVATE LIMITED | SINGLE FLANGE LEVEL TRANSMITTER (FSP-30DP-LT) | JINGDEZHEN, CHINA | DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India | 90261090 | 9491218"; "2025-03-25 | HANGZHOU CHUANHAI ENVIRONMENTAL | FLOWSTAR ENGINEERING PRIVATE LIMITED | VORTEX FLOWMETER (FSVF-25) | SHENZHEN, CHINA | Delhi Air, India | 90269000 | 9098595"; "2025-03-17 | SKEIC PTE.LTD | FLOWSTAR ENGINEERING PRIVATE LIMITED | LEVEL TRANSMITTER- MODEL (SK-R800L30) | SHANGHAI, CHINA | Delhi Air, India | 90261090 | 8930012"), which evidence importing for resale/integration, not domestic supply. Domestic supply status therefore unknown, not confirmed.
note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs bill-of-lading records, not by website claims: outbound shipments to Nepal (Sonauli LCS -> Bhairawa, 2025-12-30, HS 90261010, B/L 8334427) and Indonesia (Delhi Air -> Medan, 2025-11-18, HS 90261090, B/L 3193707), plus buyer aggregates for Bhutan and Indonesia. Declared HS 902610 matches the observed export HS codes (90261010/90261090), so no HS correction is needed; the claimed industry label 'IT и электроника' is imprecise — actual goods are industrial flow/level instrumentation (rotameters, level transmitters, vortex flowmeters), which is a note, not a rejection ground. Role: the company both exports Indian-made/assembled instruments and imports Chinese/Singaporean components (Hangzhou Chuanhai, Zhengzhou Shentai, SKEIC Pte Ltd), i.e. manufacturer_trader pattern. Slug variants tried: 'flowstar-engineering-private-limited' (70 records, populated) and 'flow-star-engineering-pvt-ltd' (page loads but zero shipment rows — no separate entity found under the spaced spelling). Revenue and export volume in value terms: null — ImportKey free view gives shipment counts only, no values; not invented. Domestic GST turnover: null, not public in reachable sources. Search engine (DuckDuckGo/searx) was down during this check, so volza/eximpedia/importgenius/trademo cross-checks and GST/GeM lookups could not be run — domestic_status is 'unknown' for lack of access, not evidence of absence. No rejection grounds: entity exists and is actively trading as of 2025-12-30.
